name: MoHowl
description: Author-motif feedback howl for NTS-3. Pad-triggered JP-8080 comb scream with feedback locked at maximum. Pitch is LFO-wobbled: X = LFO depth, Y = harmonics. RATE is LFO speed; PITCH is the center note.

params.name: LFO
params.detail: LFO depth on pitch (0 = steady, 1 = ±1 octave)

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Release time after lifting the pad
